timeline.summary: Shivalik Bimetal received a request from Solan Developers Private Limited for reclassification from promoter to public category.
Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited invites investors to its Q4 & FY2026 earnings webinar on May 20, 2026, at 3:00 PM IST, hosted by Shankhini Saha (Director-IR).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹162.63 Cr (+22.8% YoY), net profit ₹26.05 Cr (+23.8% YoY).
Shivalik Bimetal reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹570.9 Cr and PAT of ₹95.8 Cr, up 24.8% YoY.
Shivalik Bimetal deferred the launch of its new Pune manufacturing facility from April 2026 due to pending government approvals.
Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited uploaded the audio recording of its investors’ conference call for Q4FY26 results on May 20, 2026, via its website.
Shivalik Bimetal held its Q4 & FY26 earnings webinar on May 20, 2026, guiding for 20-30% growth in FY27.
Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited invites investors to an earnings webinar on 4 November 2026 at 4:00 PM IST.
